rationale: Build on the current EMA winner, but stop quant-aware training snaps from perturbing tensors that will stay float-kept in the final artifact. During the late endgame, only truly quantized tensors are blended toward the exact int8 roundtrip path, while float-kept tensors stay on the smoother training manifold and are finalized through the existing EMA plus export cast. This compounds the best script, keeps shapes and logging stable, removes a redundant pre-save roundtrip when EMA is present, and directly targets final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact val_bpb.
title: Quantized-Only Tail Snaps With Float-Kept EMA
